texts:
Monday's news, team by team, from the Rams to the Ravens, with Washington and San Francisco still to play tonight.

Davante Adams is out 6 to 10 weeks.

Jalen Hurts is done for the season.

Romeo Doubs went on IR.
#RamsHouse #FlyEaglesFly #NEPats

Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring, and Sean McVay said he will miss 6 to 10 weeks. Hold him in an IR spot; drop him only if you have no IR spot.

Matthew Stafford is QB13 rest of season for me. Trade him away while his name still sells.
#RamsHouse

Blake Grupe went on IR with the knee he hurt Sunday. Monitor; the Rams' kicker signing before Week 7.

Michael Wilson drew 7 targets @LAR, third on Arizona, with 4 catches in both games without Marvin Harrison Jr. WR40 rest of season for me; hold him.
#RamsHouse #BirdGang

Jalen Hurts has a blood clot in his leg and clots in both lungs, and he is on blood thinners with no contact allowed. He is expected to miss the rest of the season. Drop him in redraft.

Tanner McKee went 26 of 45 for 215 vs CAR.
#FlyEaglesFly #KeepPounding

Tommy Tremble caught all 4 targets for 46 and 2 TDs @PHI on 68 percent of the snaps, and ran more routes than Darren Waller. Add him in deep and TE-premium leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#KeepPounding #FlyEaglesFly

Romeo Doubs went on IR with the shoulder and misses at least four games. WR46 rest of season for me; drop him for any add unless you have an open IR spot.

DeMario Douglas caught 7 of 8 for 86 and a TD vs NYJ. Add him in PPR, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#NEPats #JetUp

TreVeyon Henderson played through the ankle vs NYJ, 7 carries for 31 on 16 snaps, and Rhamondre Stevenson still led the backs. RB26 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share @CHI Thursday night.
#NEPats #JetUp #DaBears

Omar Cooper Jr. played 82 percent of the snaps @NE in his first game off IR and caught 6 for 103 and a 48-yard TD. Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB.
#JetUp #NEPats

Roschon Johnson ran 13 times for 51 and a TD @ATL to D'Andre Swift's 16, and closed the game. Kyle Monangai (turf toe) is expected to miss Thursday vs NE. Add Johnson, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

Josh Jacobs came off the Commissioner's Exempt List and is expected to start @DET. The league's review is still open. RB37 rest of season for me; hold him, and the call changes if he is suspended.
#GoPackGo #OnePride

Cam Skattebo played 6 snaps with no touches vs NO, and John Harbaugh wants someone to step up. Hold him until Wednesday's practice report and the Week 7 depth chart.

J.J. McCarthy went 11 of 21 for 243 in relief. Monitor; Harbaugh's starter call Wednesday.
#NYGiants #Saints

Tony Pollard ran a season-high 19 times @IND. RB30 rest of season for me; hold him.

Tyjae Spears had 1 carry and 1 catch. RB55 rest of season for me; drop him for any add.
#TitanUp #ForTheShoe

Keenan Allen led the Colts with 11 targets vs TEN and caught 8 for 82, his third straight week with 9 or more. Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB.

Shane Steichen said Daniel Jones is still the starter after two interceptions.
#ForTheShoe #TitanUp

Brian Thomas Jr. was benched for the second half vs HOU, 0 catches on 2 targets. WR42 rest of season for me; trade him away for a bench receiver.

Bhayshul Tuten had 12 of the 27 rushes. RB18 rest of season for me; hold him through the bye.
#DUUUVAL #HTownMade

Lamar Jackson missed a second game with the ankle, and Jesse Minter said he could practice Wednesday before CIN. QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#RavensFlock #WhoDey

Bo Nix keeps the job; Sean Payton said there will be no change. QB19 rest of season for me. Hold him in superflex; in 1-QB leagues he is a streamer at best.

Jim Harbaugh would not commit to Mike McDaniel calling plays for the 0-6 Chargers.
#BroncosCountry #BoltUp

Every call from Monday is on the Pass, with Washington @SF still to come tonight. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
